name: Gorgias
description: Gorgias is a conversational AI platform built for ecommerce businesses, combining a helpdesk and AI agent to handle customer conversations across channels while aiming to drive revenue.
best_for: Positioned specifically for ecommerce brands and Shopify merchants — the site states Gorgias "powers customer conversations for 40% of Shopify brands," spanning clothing, beauty, subscriptions, health & wellness, and food & beverage.
features: AI support agent resolving inquiries instantly (site claims 60%)
AI shopping assistant for product recommendations/upselling
Native Shopify integration with live order/customer data
Omnichannel inbox (email, chat, SMS, WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook)
In-conversation actions (cancel order, apply discount, upsell)

alternatives.name: Freshdesk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered, easy-to-set-up customer service solution serving 74,000+ companies across industries.
alternatives.best_for: General mid-market/enterprise support teams wanting quick setup and AI ticket resolution.

alternatives.name: Crisp
alternatives.description: An all-in-one support platform with AI agents, live chat, and a shared inbox for companies of any size.
alternatives.best_for: Startups and small-to-mid businesses wanting a lightweight chat-first tool.

alternatives.name: Zoho Desk
alternatives.description: An AI-powered customer service platform that unifies support conversations across channels into one inbox, with a Zia AI assistant that handles routine tickets autonomously.
alternatives.best_for: Customer-first businesses wanting unified multichannel ticketing with AI automation

tiers.name: Starter
tiers.notes: Entry helpdesk plan; pricing scales with billable ticket volume.

cons: Helpdesk pricing is based on billable ticket usage rather than agent seats, so higher support volume can move a store into a much more expensive tier.
AI Agent is billed separately on an outcome basis, while Voice and SMS are paid add-ons, so helpdesk subscription price alone is not the full cost of an AI-heavy omnichannel setup.
